scope: Unsubtracted total held-out NLL, summed over five folds. No normalization, scoring rerun or new fit.
group_marks: Mean points, no error bars; labeled nonzero NLL axis limits for readability.
aggregation: Equal-mouse arithmetic mean of raw five-fold total NLL; no plotted error bars. SEM retained in source table only, not used to represent paired comparison uncertainty. No trial-count normalization or reference subtraction.

literature_check.adopted_feature: Subject-specific horizontal-bar display; the requested raw held-out NLL metric is retained.
